LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 2.3.1 WORD CLASSES: NOUNS

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 2
Topic 2.3: Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns, part of Strand 2 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade six ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Which things can you see and touch in the classroom and which one can you not?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1.  Listen to a story, conversation or poem containing abstract nouns and concrete nouns,  In purposive groups, collaborate to pick out concrete and abstract

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 2.3.1 Word Classes: Nouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Love is inculcated in the learner when they portray a caring attitude as they collaborate to pick out concrete and abstract nouns

from a story, conversation or poem.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life Skills Education (Self-esteem) – The learner’s self-esteem is boosted as they become more effective communicators

through practising using nouns in communication.

Link to other Subjects

The skill of correct use of concrete and abstract nouns in a variety of contexts relates to the learning of nouns in Kiswahili.
